nom: Rael Miracle Clear Brightening Carotene Pads

segments.oily: One reviewer with normally combo-to-oily skin noted the toner brightened tone without leaving skin oily, and another suggested the drying effect she experienced would suit combination-to-oily skin better than her own.
segments.dry: One reviewer said the pads left her already-dry skin drier, while others with dry or chapped patches reported no itching or burning and felt softening and hydration.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin reported the pads worked well, hydrating without breakouts and giving a glow.
segments.sensitive: Many reviewers describe their skin as sensitive or reactive and report no irritation, stinging, or breakouts, with a few appreciating the fragrance-free formula; one non-sensitive reviewer broke out badly and one sensitive-skin reviewer had irritation.
segments.normal: No reviews specifically identify normal skin as a category.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention aging or mature skin report increased dehydration and unevenness that the pads helped hydrate and even out, aided by hyaluronic acid content.

concerns.aging: Reviewers noticing age-related dehydration and unevenness report the hyaluronic-acid formula helped hydrate and balance tone, though results were described as gradual.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report the pads left skin hydrated, plump, and soft immediately after use, with a few noting the pads can feel sticky or leave residue.
concerns.redness: Reviewers dealing with redness generally report calming, non-irritating effects and reduced redness after consistent use; one reviewer reported the opposite, developing irritation.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with sensitivity or a compromised barrier report no stinging or burning even on chapped areas, describing the product as gentle compared to actives like glycolic acid or AHA.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers using the pads for hormonal acne dark spots and discoloration report visible lightening and more even tone after two or more weeks of use; one reviewer saw no noticeable change in sun spots.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or blemish-prone skin mostly report fewer breakouts and calmer skin over time; however, two reviewers experienced new or worsened breakouts, and one had a severe irritation reaction.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer noted her skin looked more radiant without becoming oily, but oiliness is not a major complaint or focus across reviews.

aspects.libelle: Pad shape awkward for full face

extraits.texte: Was super excited to try this for my acne scars and redness but unfortunately it made my skin SUPER irritated.

My skin is not sensitive by any means but these pads broke my face out incredibly bad. I love the container and the cute pincher to grab the pads but this isn't something I'd use again due to the breakout.
It's okay for me. It left my skin dryer than it already is. This might be good for someone with combination to oily skin type. This is a no for me.

Usually every single product makes me breakout like crazy. My skin is super sensitive and gets little bumps that I have been having trouble getting to go away. I use these every night and my face feels AMAZING after and by the morning still. It hydrates so well, my skin is usually combo but this product just works so well for me. I highly recommend giving these a try, my friends and family have tried this based on my recommendation as well and have also had great results. I want to try more of their products in the future!

I have acne prone skin, currently under control but I still get the occasional hormonal acne. I am pretty strict with my skin routine and this has fit perfectly into it. I use it every other night, adapalene when I'm not using this. I have had great results, doesn't irritate my skin and brightens my skin. I scar frequently, after 2 weeks of using the pads, I noticed a difference.

I recently received these pads to sample and give my honest review. I do like how the pads are packaged. Keeps each pad "wet", rather than them drying out over time. As I've gotten older, I've noticed my skin is becoming more dehydrated and in need of more moisture. And the appearance of my skin just seems to be more "imbalanced". I have used these pads for over a week, and can say I have noticed a difference in the overall appearance of my skin. The uneven skin tones seem to have minimized, and my skin feels more hydrated as well. I have used them for a quick "toning" and exfoliator, and also have left them on my face for a bit to give my skin the extra nourishment. I love that these pads include eight types of Hyaluronic Acid, which my skin definitely is in need of now that I'm older. And that they have a multi use option. I am also one who has sensitivity issues at times with skin care, and I did not experience any issues with these pads. Overall, I would recommend these pads to anyone who's skin is in need of an extra boost of hydration, and looking to even out skin tone.

extraits.titre: Awesome packaging, good for my sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I love products that have a nice presentation. The packaging is nice and eye catching. It looks good as part of my skin care collection. The pads are small and have a gel feel on one side that is soothing. The other side is textured. I have very sensitive skin and I had no irritation. I use this daily or every other day. I have melasma on both cheeks and work daily to even my skin. I've seen minor improvement and hope to see better results after 30 days
